data.description: 4BR Penthouse | Sea View | Le Reve Dubai Marina
data.long_description:
Zoya Ventures Real Estate is delighted to introduce this half-floor four-bedroom penthouse in Le Reve, one of Dubai Marina’s most exclusive residential towers. Designed for those who value privacy, space and discretion, it offers far reaching sea and skyline views from a landmark address favoured by high profile residents.

Extending to approx. 585 sq m (6,297 sq ft), the residence is composed around a grand open plan living and dining space with panoramic glazing. A separate chef’s kitchen supports formal entertaining, while a study provides a quiet retreat for work or reading. Four-bedroom suites, each with its own bathroom, create a refined family layout, complemented by immaculate finishes and high-quality furnishings throughout.

Property Details:

4 bedrooms
5 bathrooms
BUA 585 sq m
Half-floor layout
Study room
Chef’s kitchen
1 parking space
Furnished condition

Key Features:

Panoramic sea views
Spacious living
Luxury finishes
Exclusive tower
High privacy
End user/investor

Community Overview:

Le Reve is an iconic tower at the edge of Dubai Marina, known for its large simplex and duplex residences, exceptional security and discreet, concierge-led service. Residents enjoy easy access to Marina Walk, beachfront hotels, dining, retail and major road links, placing the city’s key business and leisure districts within convenient reach.
